g.title: j2503646915
g.text: I have been thinking over this whole situation with the butler and the family upstairs. It is entirely untenable.

g.title: j229789664
g.text: I have been thinking on this matter of the butler and Albrecht's family upstairs. And how much I am looking forward to "reuniting them."

g.title: j915191394
g.text: I have been thinking on this matter of the butler and Albrecht's family upstairs. And how much I am looking forward to reuniting them.

g.title: j2030691050
g.text: If I am to be any manner of asset, or if I am to be of any kind of use to anyone, I cannot do it trapped down here in secret.

g.title: j3869792330
g.text: I cannot remain trapped down here in secret. If I am to wield my influence upon the world, I must be able to work in public.

g.title: j433074883
g.text: Besides which, Albrecht's family likely has resources and access to items I will need. Do you see what I'm getting at?

g.title: j4058491942
g.text: Though I fear it will not much matter, since you bungled it so badly with both the zealots.

g.title: j2360863065
g.text: Though I fear it will not much matter, since you bungled it so badly with Marie.

g.title: j1902439700
g.text: Though I fear it will not much matter, since you bungled it so badly with Lyon.

g.title: j1020084461
g.text: The zealots are eager as well, if for very different reasons than mine. Well done in convincing them.

g.title: j3964269870
g.text: Marie is eager as well, if for a different reason than mine. Now we just wait to see if you can convince Lyon. Try not to bungle that up, if you can.

g.title: j4064577138
g.text: Lyon is eager as well, if for a different reason than mine. Now we just wait to see if you can convince Marie. Try not to bungle that up, if you can.

g.title: j1014656558
g.text: I think it's better if you all stay down here in secret. Sorry.

g.title: j2583589686
g.text: All right. Fine. Let's try to get Loid up those stairs.

g.title: j2806535834
g.text: Is there anything you can do to help me with that?

g.title: j46902153
g.text: Is there anything you can do to help me with that?

g.title: j3315727755
g.text: Is there anything you can do to help me with that?

g.title: j3246564338
g.text: I wonder how Albrecht will react when he gets back.

g.title: j1480414123
g.text: I wonder how the Entrati family will react.

g.title: j450479591
g.text: What "reasons" do you have to want to see Loid and the Entrati family reunited?

g.title: j3243079973
g.text: You know me. Always an inspirational source of motivation. But you know, if you get discouraged, you could always... what is the phrase?

g.title: j4254030186
g.text: I think I could be of assistance in this regard, yes. And it does suit my needs to inspire them to give you a second chance in convincing them to help, I suppose.

g.title: j2441084160
g.text: I think I could be of assistance in this regard, yes. And it does suit my needs to inspire them to give you a second chance in convincing her to help, I suppose.

g.title: j431719368
g.text: I think I could be of assistance in this regard, yes. And it does suit my needs to inspire them to give you a second chance in convincing him to help, I suppose.

g.title: j2053598847
g.text: "When?" Ha! I doubt that bastard will ever set foot in this place again.

g.title: j3052045808
g.text: We will not have long to wait until we find out, I hope. I am more curious how they will react to my insistence that they accept my protection.

g.title: j2982523328
g.text: Several. First, I am tired of mouldering down here in this duplicate crypt like I am some animal in a zoo enclosure.

g.title: j323069518
g.text: I realize now that this was a mistake. You are an immense waste of time. How wonderful for you that you can repeat it at will.

g.title: j4000645005
g.text: You are an immense waste of time. How wonderful for you that you can repeat it at will.

g.title: j2744941057
g.text: Mouldering down here in this duplicate crypt like I am some animal in a zoo enclosure is growing to be less and less amusing by the day.

g.title: j2440761949
g.text: Mouldering down here in this duplicate crypt like I am some animal in a zoo enclosure is growing to be less and less amusing by the day.

g.title: j3341778261
g.text: Mouldering down here in this duplicate crypt like I am some animal in a zoo enclosure is growing to be less and less amusing by the day.

g.title: j2133180724
g.text: Euleria is no fool. She will know my motivation for doing so. I doubt she will accept it without some level of unease.

g.title: j817432686
g.text: That is now your only recourse at this point should you ever wish to change your mind.

g.title: j2528978835
g.text: I am glad to see I can temper your wanton stubbornness, Drifter darling.

g.title: j671630143
g.text: The stubborn creature is not so immutable as it seems. Finally!

g.title: j4164974377
g.text: But there is only so much strong-arming I can do with them. Understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.

g.title: j2544152297
g.text: But there is only so much strong-arming I can do with Marie. Understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.

g.title: j2446889337
g.text: But there is only so much strong-arming I can do with Lyon. Understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.

g.title: j2113686582
g.text: No, Drifter darling. I think Albrecht has quit this place and his family once and for all. I doubt he will ever lay eyes on his daughter again.

g.title: j2726407912
g.text: No, Drifter. I think Albrecht has quit this place and his family once and for all. I doubt he will ever lay eyes on his daughter again.

g.title: j251788523
g.text: What are your motivations, anyway? You never said.

g.title: j3117565542
g.text: Would you blame her for not trusting you?

g.title: j1108993125
g.text: Second, it strikes me as a kind of penance to pay, to protect Deimos and the Entrati family from what may come when Albrecht's debts come due.

g.title: j743458310
g.text: Second, what better way to get my revenge against Albrecht? Yes, I took the serum willingly, but he is the one who threw me into the past.

g.title: j1314412781
g.text: We will have to do this one at a time. Let us begin with the more logical-minded of the two. The priest.

g.title: j3303136376
g.text: Several. First, I am tired of mouldering down here in this duplicate crypt like I am some animal in a zoo enclosure.

g.title: j2914943925
g.text: Of course not! She would see through me clear as day. Nor would I try to hide what would be so obvious to read to someone as clever as her.

g.title: j1792785454
g.text: The family will need protection. I should be standing guard. I cannot do that when I am locked in the basement.

g.title: j2893887255
g.text: He is the one who destroyed my memories and ensured I would have no one other than you to turn to retrieve them.

g.title: j2119083613
g.text: But you likely know that as well as I.

g.title: j2726671935
g.text: And it is best for their sake that he never does.

g.title: j334502327
g.text: The question simply remains, will the other two aid us in our endeavor? This will take a coordinated effort.

g.title: j987540857
g.text: Why, because of the pain that would cause them?

g.title: j1578630741
g.text: Why, because of the pain that would cause them?

g.title: j292847487
g.text: Second, it strikes me as a kind of penance to pay, to protect Deimos and the Entrati family from what may come when Albrecht's debts come due.

g.title: j86735049
g.text: Second, what better way to get my revenge against Albrecht? Yes, I took the serum willingly, but he is the one who threw me into the past.

g.title: j3854733119
g.text: She knows that she would need me to protect Deimos and the rest of her family from what may come when Albrecht's debts come due.

g.title: j229875328
g.text: She would know I was there to get revenge against Albrecht. Yes, I took the serum willingly, but he is the one who threw me into the past.

g.title: j936104482
g.text: Mark my words, "God" or no? The Indifference will come for what is owed to him. And when that day comes, Drifter darling?

g.title: j3613837657
g.text: Mark my words, "God" or no? The Indifference will come for what is owed to him. And when that day comes?

g.title: j2920681016
g.text: And while, yes, you turned out to be more... delicious than I would have thought you to be, Drifter dear, how was that a guarantee?

g.title: j2943579868
g.text: I will protect Deimos. I will protect the Void heart. More importantly, I will protect Albrecht's family.

g.title: j3182179819
g.text: No. Likely because he fears what he would bring back with him. Although it is far too late for that.

g.title: j2246043178
g.text: In a roundabout way, yes. For you see, I will protect Deimos. I will protect the Void heart. More importantly, I will protect Albrecht's family.

g.title: j2258694240
g.text: The family will need protection. I should be standing guard. I cannot do that when I am locked in the basement.

g.title: j923160939
g.text: He is the one who destroyed my memories and ensured I would have no one other than you to turn to retrieve them.

g.title: j207593570
g.text: The family will need protection. And they are all a bit "rooted to the spot" as it were, yes?

g.title: j1427439508
g.text: But it will be worth the risk. She has no other means of protecting Deimos. Or her family.

g.title: j1526833635
g.text: Right until he watches me murder them before his eyes.

g.title: j3129975610
g.text: Neither of them will help us. ... Sorry.

g.title: j1778833798
g.text: Marie won't help us. I don't know about Lyon yet.

g.title: j1355430311
g.text: Lyon won't help us. I don't know about Marie yet.

g.title: j64020774
g.text: They're both on board to help us.

g.title: j1801187352
g.text: Marie will help us, but I don't know about Lyon yet.

g.title: j2093184761
g.text: Lyon will help us, but I don't know about Marie yet.

g.title: j1392403364
g.text: Lyon will help us, but Marie won't.

g.title: j2653326732
g.text: Marie will help us, but Lyon won't.

g.title: j2637266432
g.text: I will protect Deimos. I will protect the Void heart. More importantly, I will protect Albrecht's family.

g.title: j1309525904
g.text: There will be Hell to pay.

g.title: j1132094854
g.text: Mark my words. The day Albrecht returns?

g.title: j3017928103
g.text: I am not sure what I was expecting...

g.title: j2416476623
g.text: How in the name of the Void did you manage to bungle it with the both of them?!

g.title: j2291911443
g.text: Of course you managed to bungle things with her. Of course, you did.

g.title: j2534295853
g.text: How did you manage to bungle things with the priest?! He's the logical one of the two!

g.title: j787710492
g.text: Of course you managed to bungle things with her. Of course, you did.

g.title: j3055985081
g.text: How did you manage to bungle things with the priest?! He's the logical one of the two!

g.title: j4264969847
g.text: Right until he watches me murder them before his eyes.

g.title: j3262932650
g.text: Very well. I will do what I can to clean up this mess for you. But understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.

g.title: j3905393091
g.text: Very well. I will do what I can to clean up this mess for you. But understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.

g.title: j2299937019
g.text: Very well. I will do what I can to clean up this mess for you. But understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.

g.title: j3685110067
g.text: Fantastic. Now the work can begin. But this will take time. I recommend patience. If such a thing is possible.

g.title: j3985178887
g.text: Hm. Well, it is a start. Try not to bungle things up with Lyon in the meanwhile, yes?

g.title: j4198190166
g.text: Hm. Well, it is a start. Try not to bungle things up with Marie in the meanwhile, yes?

g.title: j2342684906
g.text: Very well. I will do what I can to clean up this mess for you. But understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.

g.title: j360049452
g.text: Very well. I will do what I can to clean up this mess for you. But understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.

g.title: j2074013711
g.text: Simply try not to botch things with the priest while I work on convincing Marie to give you a second chance to explain yourself. Yes?

g.title: j3326261931
g.text: Simply try not to botch things with Marie while I work on convincing Lyon to give you a second chance to explain yourself. Yes?
